steps.say: Every decision is written down: what the agent saw, what it chose, and the fingerprint of the record before it.

steps.text: What the agent saw, when it chose

steps.say: One click checks the whole chain.
When a charge is disputed, Sentry builds the response from this evidence, and code decides the verdict. First, the rogue purchase.
Mandate breach. Sentry says accept the claim, instead of defending a purchase it should never have allowed.
And when the agent behaved, the same process gives a defensible verdict: provide the evidence, and the record proves it.
Sentry. Signed mandates, tamper-evident evidence, and honest dispute answers, on the PayPal sandbox.
